import pandas as pd

def load_and_concat_sources(source_files):
    """
    Load multiple CSV source files and concatenate them into a single DataFrame.
    """
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file)
        dfs.append(df)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    return combined_df

def enforce_schema(df):
    """
    Enforce the target schema data types on the DataFrame.
    """
    # Define the target schema with expected types
    schema = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # Use pandas nullable integer dtype
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # Convert columns to the target types
    for col, dtype in schema.items():
        if col in df.columns:
            # For string columns, convert to string dtype explicitly
            if dtype == 'string':
                df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
            else:
                # For integer columns, use pandas nullable Int64 dtype to handle missing values safely
                try:
                    df[col] = df[col].astype(dtype)
                except Exception as e:
                    # If conversion fails, try coercing errors to NaN and then convert
                    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)
        else:
            # If column missing, create it with NaNs of appropriate type
            if dtype == 'string':
                df[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA]*len(df), dtype='string')
            elif dtype.startswith('Int'):
                df[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA]*len(df), dtype='Int64')
            else:
                df[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA]*len(df), dtype=dtype)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    df = df[list(schema.keys())]

    return df

def main():
    # List all source CSV file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Load and concatenate all source data
    combined_df = load_and_concat_sources(source_files)

    # Enforce target schema and data types
    transformed_df = enforce_schema(combined_df)

    # Write the transformed DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    transformed_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
